newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on profit-taking.

text.p: After four staight days of gains, Thai stocks were expected to decline on Thursday as investors were likely to sell and take profits, brokers said.

"Investors are likely to sell and take profits today as they await fresh news. Turnover is expected to be thin today as there's no positive news to drive investment," said a broker at a foreign brokerage house.
The SET composite index finished up 0.32 point at 720.27 on active trade of 7.9 billion baht turnover on Wednesday. The SET-50 index slipped 0.03 point to 53.64.

Thaneit Khantigaroon of Ekachart Finance and Securities said cabinet approval on Tuesday to issue zero-coupon bonds to aid the ailing property sector seemed to have already been digested by investors.
"I think there will be several bouts of profit-taking today," Thaneit said.
